declaration.source: switch, not a material value: 1 gives every membrane face a lipid COUNT as state and lets that material move between faces along the tension difference (physics.surface_count_flow), so the face-area constraint projects onto N_f x membrane.lipid_area_per_molecule instead of the area the face was built with (area_constraint_reference = 'count'). 0 leaves the build and the step byte-identical, which is the shipped value: this changes the membrane's constitutive behaviour and the merged head still has an unexplained membrane volume-flux instability on the device (INVENTORY E21/E22) that must be resolved before the default path carries it. parameter_reviews.name: membrane.inplane_friction

declaration.source: PI-GAP, and a STAND-IN that is to be REPLACED rather than sourced. The in-plane flow law v = grad(sigma)/b needs a drag per unit area per unit in-plane velocity; membrane-cortex friction is reported around 1e8-1e9 Pa.s/m (tether-pulling and flow measurements of the Shi/Baumgart kind; 1 Pa.s/m = 1e-6 pN.s/um^3, so 1e2-1e3 in these units) — quoted from memory, NOT read in a paper here and NOT in the KB source_audit, hence EXAMPLE and hence a range that is exploratory and not a confidence interval. The PI's decision (OPTIONS-2026-09-21 item 3) is that this coefficient should EMERGE from the making and breaking of the explicit ERM relations that tie the bilayer to the cortex, the way composite viscosity must be an observable and not an input (directive 9). This row exists so the flow law can run before that emergence is built, and is to be deleted when it is.

parameter_reviews.finding: Source1700±300 is a related HeLa obstacle-model estimate, not validation of current1000 or an independent material prior. Current declaration calls the coefficient a replaceable stand-in.

review_snapshot.name: membrane.inplane_flow_enabled

declaration.source: switch, not a material value: 1 gives every membrane face a lipid COUNT as state and lets that material move between faces along the tension difference (physics.surface_count_flow), so the face-area constraint projects onto N_f x membrane.lipid_area_per_molecule instead of the area the face was built with (area_constraint_reference = 'count'). 0 leaves the build and the step byte-identical, which is the shipped value: this changes the membrane's constitutive behaviour and the merged head still has an unexplained membrane volume-flux instability on the device (INVENTORY E21/E22) that must be resolved before the default path carries it. Without it a tether cannot form and, under plate compression, the contact zone and the free zone cannot exchange membrane, so the membrane tension is artificially non-uniform in exactly the experiment that reads cortical tension.

review_snapshot.name: membrane.inplane_friction

declaration.source: PI-GAP, and a STAND-IN that is to be REPLACED rather than sourced. The in-plane flow law v = grad(sigma)/b needs a drag per unit area per unit in-plane velocity; membrane-cortex friction is reported around 1e8-1e9 Pa.s/m (tether-pulling and flow measurements of the Shi/Baumgart kind; 1 Pa.s/m = 1e-6 pN.s/um^3, so 1e2-1e3 in these units) — quoted from memory, NOT read in a paper here and NOT in the KB source_audit, hence EXAMPLE and hence a range that is exploratory and not a confidence interval. The PI's decision (OPTIONS-2026-09-21 item 3) is that this coefficient should EMERGE from the making and breaking of the explicit ERM relations that tie the bilayer to the cortex, the way composite viscosity must be an observable and not an input (directive 9). This row exists so the flow law can run before that emergence is built, and is to be deleted when it is.
